arguments.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_spent_usd FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.credit_limit_usd_cents > 2000000
arguments.explanation: Adds up the amounts of all transactions made on cards with a credit limit above $20,000, shown in dollars.
assumptions: Spent means the sum of all transaction amounts on those cards, including the negative amounts (not treated as refunds or removed).
All transactions are included, labelled or not, since this is a spending total rather than a fraud rate.
Covers the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
